title: Gateway Invasion!
description: This mod adds a collapsed dimension!
body:
**GATEWAY INVASION!**

This mod adds a new dimension named The Gateway, a dimension long forgotten by the human civilization or anyone.

HOW TO ACESSS?

To make the portal, you need 2 items:
Warped Hyphae (A concentraded block of Warped Oak, Vanilla Item) and a Flint and Glitch, a odd variant of the Flint and Steel

MOBS!

Breezes and Creakings naturally spawn in the dimension.

Converted Creepers - Blue Creepers that shoot arrows at players and Watchers, their mortal enemies
Glees - Soul Sand Ghasts that fire fireballs, main flying threat
Brines - A Water Elemental..oddly found outside water, stationary and attacks any close players.
Watchers - a Hybrid between Guardian and Piglins, only found in the Watcher Bastion, neutral and agressive toward Converted Creepers.
The Flower - A mutant version of the creaking, spawns randomly over the dimension.

This was a passion project, and the sequel towards it is coming...

Official Wiki: https://glitched-infection.fandom.com/wiki/Glitched_Infection_Wiki
